headline: General Strike: On 20 November Italy Stops. Workers Take to the Streets Also in Umbria
summary: Workers will strike across Italy on 20 November, with marches planned in Perugia and Terni. CGIL General Secretary Maurizio Landini will address a workers' assembly at Nestlé-Perugina.
why: General strikes disrupt transport and production and signal labour tensions that can affect economic output and policy debates in Italy.
